name: Shellington's Diary
shortDescription: A field diary kept in a steady hand, then a worse one.
examineDescription:
Forty pages of careful field notes: weather, bearings, what the crows did and when. The handwriting is neat for thirty-eight of them.

The last two are the same hand pressed harder. "The creatures out here are not what we were taught they are. They do not behave like animals defending a place. They behave like something is asking them to." Then, lower down, in letters that dig into the paper: "It asked me too. I wrote down that I said no."
